blocks.text: Pacific Douglas homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Pacific Douglas, September 2026. Detached houses: 39 listed at month end and 6 sold in September, a sales ratio of 15% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 25 listed at month end and 4 sold in September, a sales ratio of 16% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 13 sold over 4 months against an average of 35.2 listed, about 10.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 6 sold. Condos and townhomes: 11 sold over 4 months against an average of 21.2 listed, about 7.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 6 sold.

faq.q: Is Pacific Douglas the same place as Douglas, Surrey?
faq.a: Yes — "Pacific Douglas" is the Paragon/MLS sub-area name; the City of Surrey calls the neighbourhood Douglas, "Surrey's most southern urban neighbourhood," located between the Peace Arch and Pacific border crossings adjacent to the United States.

faq.q: How did Pacific Douglas sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached: 39 listings, 6 sold, a 15% sales ratio — the second-highest published detached ratio in S Surrey White Rock that month, behind Hazelmere's 29%. Condos & Townhomes: 25 listings, 4 sold, 16%. No sub-area median is published for Pacific Douglas, and the community medians (detached $1,628,000; attached $700,000) are not Pacific Douglas figures (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which plan guides land use in Douglas now?
faq.a: The Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan — the City states the Douglas plan's land use designations "have been superseded by the Surrey 2050 – Official Community Plan Update corporate report," with zoning under Surrey Zoning By-law No. 12000.
